source: If 1 TB of requests arrive at L2 and a large fraction are served there, ZXNAME0000XZ may see far less than 1 TB of read traffic. If most requests miss, ZXNAME0001XZ sees much more of the demand. Nsight’s memory tables expose hit rates and sector misses specifically to make this distinction visible.[3]
zh: 如果 1 TB 的请求到达 L2，并且大部分请求在那里得到服务，则 ZXNAME0000XZ 可能会看到远少于 1 TB 的读取流量。如果大多数请求未命中，ZXNAME0001XZ 会看到更多的需求。 Nsight 的内存表专门公开了命中率和扇区缺失，以使这种区别可见。[3]
